updates.title: Technician names and avatar hover names match the staff record in both views
preconditions: You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.

Technicians {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Staffname Ana) and {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Staffname Ben) are active staff members at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.

Where the site allows it, each technician's staff record name differs from the name on their sign-in account (for example staff record ZZAUTOTEST Staffname Ana, account ZZAUTOTEST Account Ana). On staging the two names cannot differ, because renaming either one renames both, so there every name simply has to match Settings > Staff.
Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST S5R11b Staff Names") is used by this case only.

Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17791) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A} and has two approved lines, {Line-1} and {Line-2} (for example "Service - Full grease service" twice).
{Line-2}'s technician is {Technician-B}, set through Edit Line.
List shows the Lead Technician column, Board View's Fields to display has Lead technician and Line technicians on, and Tech View shows the Assigned Techs column (it is on by default).
On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
steps: Click your initials (top right) and open Settings > Staff.
Write down the names shown for {Technician-A} and {Technician-B}.
Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click List in the display switcher.
Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
Read the Lead Technician of {Work-order-1}.
Click Board View in the display switcher.
Read the lead technician name on {Work-order-1}'s card.
Read the header of the column that holds {Work-order-1}.
Hover each avatar in the card's line technicians, and the +N if one shows, and read each name.
Click Tech View in the display switcher.
Read the header of the group that holds {Work-order-1}.
Hover each avatar in {Work-order-1}'s Assigned Techs cell, and the +N if one shows, and read each name.
results: Step 5: List's Lead Technician shows {Technician-A}'s staff record name, as written down at step 2.
Step 7: the card's lead technician name is the same staff record name.
Step 8: the column header shows {Technician-A}'s staff record name.
Step 9: the names shown on hover are the staff record names of {Technician-A} and {Technician-B}, as written down at step 2.
Step 11: the group header shows {Technician-A}'s staff record name.
Step 12: the names shown on hover are the staff record names of {Technician-A} and {Technician-B}.
Steps 5 to 12: no other name for either technician appears anywhere (for example not ZZAUTOTEST Account Ana).
updates.source: Epic SV-10043; story SV-10048 (Story 5, Choose what is shown); SV-10050 (Story 7, Line technicians); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 54 (15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S5-R11b, S2-R10, S7-R1, S7-R6, S2-R12 and S3-R12, read 15 Oct 2026. S5-R11b was added in version 49 from Chris Ward's answer 4 (14 Oct 2026) and widened in version 54 from answer 23 to every name in both views, avatar hover names included. Developer note (Slack #fs-board-tech-view, 12 Oct 2026): staff record and account names can differ on the QA data. Staging keeps one name per technician (found by the test-run session on 15 Oct 2026). Product owner answers: Chris Ward, WO Board and Tech View question sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gBGmNB4B1bRrD2ZJvBn1tuvbfxFPjcsKddz_I5H3CvU), answers 4 and 23, read 15 Oct 2026. Source-verified 15 October 2026. The previous version of this case was run on staging (build v26.40.17-a5c4210) on 10/15/2026, before the expected results changed on 15 Oct 2026; the changed results have not yet been checked against a build.
quotes: S5-R11b

Every technician name in Tech View and Board View, on cards, rows, group headers, column headers and the names shown on hover over any technician avatar (S2-R10, S7-R1), is the technician’s staff record name, the same name the List’s Lead Technician column shows.
Hovering a technician header or avatar reveals the technician’s name.
S7-R1

Board View cards (when the line technicians field is on) and a new optional Assigned Techs column in Tech View show a compact avatar group: the lead technician plus the distinct technicians assigned to work order lines. List does not get this column.
S7-R6
Keep every involved technician discoverable by name.

Each group header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that group, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the rows listed.

Each column header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that column, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the cards listed.

doc_part1: Sign in as an Owner or Admin user. On a QA site click the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". To check the permissions: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders: View and Create & Edit are on.

Pick one location for the whole case; it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (to change it: your initials > Change Location). This is {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). Create everything below at {Location-A}.
Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, with no display switcher).

Your initials > Settings > Staff. Reuse a staff member only if they are active, have Time Clock on, {Location-A} in Location and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User. Otherwise click New Staff Member and enter First Name and Last Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Staffname Ana), an Email, Role Technician, at least one Department (required), Location {Location-A}, turn Time Clock on, then Save & Close. This is {Technician-A}.

Your initials > Settings > Staff. Reuse a staff member only if they are active, have Time Clock on, {Location-A} in Location and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User. Otherwise click New Staff Member and enter First Name and Last Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Staffname Ben), an Email, Role Technician, at least one Department (required), Location {Location-A}, turn Time Clock on, then Save & Close. This is {Technician-B}.

Names: on a QA site, compare each technician's name in Settings > Staff with the name their own account shows after they sign in (their initials > Edit Profile). If you can find two technicians whose two names differ, use them as {Technician-A} and {Technician-B}. On staging the names never differ; use any two technicians.

Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name (for example "ZZAUTOTEST S5R11b Staff Names") > Save. This is {Customer-A}; use it for this case only. On the customer page click Contacts > New Contact > First Name and Last Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Contact) > Save. Then Assets > New Asset > pick the contact, Year (for example 2022), Make (type "Freight" and pick Freightliner), Model (for example M2), Unit (for example TRK-118) > Save. Contact and Make are required.

Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick {Customer-A} and its asset > Save (if a Confirmation about the credit limit appears, click Create). The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form. In What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service", turn Line Approved on and click Save & Close. The status reads Approved. Write down the number shown at the top left (for example S10043-17791). This is {Work-order-1}. On {Work-order-1}'s page pick {Technician-A} in the Lead Technician dropdown; it saves at once (the dropdown shows once the work order is Approved).

On {Work-order-1}'s Lines tab the first line is {Line-1}. Click New Line, type "grease", pick "Service - Full grease service", turn Line Approved on and click Save & Close: this is {Line-2}. On {Line-2} click Edit Line, pick {Technician-B} as its technician and save.

Work Orders > All > List > Column Selection: turn Lead Technician on. Board View > Fields to display: turn Lead technician and Line technicians on. Tech View: check the Assigned Techs column shows (it is on by default).
Work Orders > All: clear any Status selection, click the x on the Asset on Site chip if it shows Yes or No, turn Assigned to me off and empty Search.
Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All > List > Search the name of {Customer-A} shows {Work-order-1} with Lead Technician {Technician-A}. Then empty Search.
doc_part2: Goal: one work order led by {Technician-A} with {Technician-B} on a line; compare every name shown in the two views with Settings > Staff.

Record each technician's staff record name and account name, and every rendered name (visible text and the hover text) on the List, the card, the column header, the group header and both avatar groups.
Evidence: a screenshot after each step that has an expected result, the build marker, and the real value of every brace name.
updates.change_summary: Rewritten in full to the Rule 117 layout (own setup Doc; it had no doc link after the 15 Oct rewrite). Answer 23 / PRD v54 S5-R11b: the avatar hover names on cards and in Tech View rows must also be the staff record name (was: each technician can be found by name). Staging's one-name limit is stated in the preconditions. Retest.
updates.divergence: Until 15 Oct 2026 the PRD named only cards and headers, and this case only checked that each technician could be found by name in a row's avatars. Chris Ward answered on 15 Oct 2026 (answer 23) that every technician name in both views, avatar hover names included, is the staff record name; PRD version 54 says so. On staging a technician's staff record and sign-in account always carry the same name, so there the case shows that every name matches Settings > Staff but cannot show which of the two the screen reads; run it where the names can differ to prove that.

updates.title: The lead of an Invoiced or Paid work order cannot be changed in any way
preconditions: You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
Technician {Technician-A} (for example Esther Howard) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
Technician {Technician-B} (for example Ralph Edwards) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.

Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Invoiced Paid Locked") is used by this case only and has six work orders whose Lead Technician was set while they were still open (for example S10043-17801 to S10043-17806): {Work-order-1} Approved, led by {Technician-A}; {Work-order-2} Invoiced, led by {Technician-A}; {Work-order-3} Paid, led by {Technician-A}; {Work-order-4} Invoiced, with no lead technician; {Work-order-5} Declined, led by {Technician-A}; {Work-order-6} Complete, led by {Technician-A}.
No technician has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders.
On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
steps: Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Board View in the display switcher.
Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
Drag {Work-order-2}'s card from {Technician-A}'s column into {Technician-B}'s column.
Drag {Work-order-2}'s card into the Unassigned column.
Drag {Work-order-2}'s card within {Technician-A}'s column to above {Work-order-1}.
Drag {Work-order-3}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column, then into the Unassigned column, then within {Technician-A}'s column to above {Work-order-1}.
Drag {Work-order-4}'s card into {Technician-A}'s column, then drag it to a new place within the Unassigned column.
Drag {Work-order-5}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column (click Keep shifts if asked).
Drag {Work-order-6}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column (click Keep shifts if asked).
Open {Work-order-2} and try to change Lead Technician on the work order page.
Go back, click Tech View in the display switcher and do steps 3 to 7 again with the rows, then drag {Work-order-5} and {Work-order-6} from {Technician-B}'s group back into {Technician-A}'s group.
results: Steps 3, 4 and 6: {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3} cannot be moved to {Technician-B} or to Unassigned: the card goes back to {Technician-A}'s column and the lead stays {Technician-A}.
Steps 5 and 6: {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3} can be moved within {Technician-A}'s column and keep their new place.
Step 7: {Work-order-4} cannot be moved out of Unassigned, but it can be reordered inside it.
Steps 8 and 9: {Work-order-5} (Declined) and {Work-order-6} (Complete) move to {Technician-B} normally, with "Lead technician updated".
Step 10: on the work order page the Lead Technician of {Work-order-2} cannot be changed either.

Step 11: Tech View follows the same rules for every move. A change sent outside the screens is also refused by the server; this part cannot be checked by hand, so write "server refusal not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see. Imported work orders are checked in their own case.
updates.source: Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 54 (15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R10, S4-N2 and Key decision: lead locked once Invoiced or Paid, read 15 Oct 2026. In version 48 (12 Oct 2026) S4-N2 dropped Imported from the locked statuses (Imported work orders now open in List only); the Invoiced and Paid rules this case checks are unchanged, so the expected results are unchanged. quotes: Enforce the prohibited-status rule in S4-N2 on every lead-change path, including requests that bypass interface controls.
S4-N2

Do not allow the lead technician to change in Invoiced or Paid status. An Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder it within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but it cannot be moved to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned. Declined and Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today.
Key decision: lead locked once Invoiced or Paid

Lead technician cannot be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid. This is a product rule, not only a screen rule, so it must hold on every path that changes the lead technician — board drag, Reassign dialog, and the work order detail page.

updates.title: Invoiced and Paid work orders can only be reordered within their technician
preconditions: You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
Technician {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.

Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock") is used by this case only and has six work orders (for example S10043-17811 to S10043-17816): {Work-order-1} Approved, {Work-order-2} Invoiced, {Work-order-3} Paid, {Work-order-4} Declined and {Work-order-5} Complete, all led by {Technician-A}, and {Work-order-6} Invoiced with no lead technician.
No technician has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders.
On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
steps: Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
Click Board View in the display switcher.
Look at the {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3} cards and hover the lock or any marker on them.
Drag {Work-order-2}'s card above {Work-order-1}'s card inside {Technician-A}'s column and release it.
Drag {Work-order-2}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column and release it.
Drag {Work-order-3}'s card into the Unassigned column and release it.
Drag {Work-order-6}'s card from Unassigned into {Technician-A}'s column and release it.
Drag {Work-order-4}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column and release it, then drag {Work-order-5}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column and release it.
Click Tech View in the display switcher.
Drag {Work-order-3}'s row into {Technician-B}'s group and release it.
results: Step 4: {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3} show that they can only be reordered within {Technician-A}'s work, not moved to another technician (the design shows a lock with the text "Invoiced · can't be reassigned"). Write down the words you see where they differ from these; a different label alone is not a fail.
Step 5: {Work-order-2} moves above {Work-order-1}. Reordering within the same technician is allowed.

Step 9: {Work-order-4} (Declined) and {Work-order-5} (Complete) move to {Technician-B}'s column with "Lead technician updated".
Step 11: the same rule holds in Tech View. {Work-order-3} stays in {Technician-A}'s group.

quotes: S9-N1
Apply S4-N1 and S4-N2’s permission and status restrictions to every work order drag.
S4-N2

Do not allow the lead technician to change in Invoiced or Paid status. An Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder it within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but it cannot be moved to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned. Declined and Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today.
S4-N7
Visually indicate that an Invoiced or Paid work order can only be reordered within its current technician, not moved to another one.
Tech plan 3.23 lead lock vs reorder

In a locked status a work order can be dragged within its current technician (or within Unassigned if it has no lead); it cannot be dropped on another technician, and cannot move between a technician and Unassigned.
